subject: prd/incident-machinery
statement: When invoked as `graduate` with an incident ID and a principle ID, the writer shall append `Graduated: AP-<n>` to that entry's `Links:` line — the one sanctioned mutation — and shall fail if the entry does not exist or already carries a graduation pointer.
rationale: graduation stops being a hand edit to an append-only file
fit_criterion: graduating a fixture entry grows only its `Links:` line (append-only check green); a second graduation of the same entry red; an unknown ID red
